label: The objective reality of every occurring idea has a cause
paraphrase: P2 of the idea-of-the-infinite argument, analyst formulation (navigation: Descartes, Meditation III; attribution deferred): for every occurring episode e and perfection r, if e represents r then some being c is a cause of e's representing r (ObjCause, the cause of an idea's objective reality, not of the idea's being). Nothing is said of uniqueness or totality of that cause. Open.
